review_notes: Confirm task registration by shortcut direction, the Zanaris wall’s Agility XP, and actual approach and retry times in game. The draft includes no wall XP.
The waka draft supports four catalogued axes. Add other axe tiers and ordinary canoe services when their routes are collected.
The 153-kudos gate uses the shared museum counter. The current catalog requires all modeled kudos sources to meet it.
Confirm how Prayer points affect registration at each altar. The draft asks the player to verify Smite is active and retry if needed.
The Cosmic Altar route supports a worn cosmic tiara and 28 pure essence. The itinerary calls out temporary bank storage and retrieval because the inventory model does not enforce the 28-slot loadout.
Verify the absence of XP for lighting the helmet, the exact area boundaries for all three amulet stages, and the diary credit after equipping the tailored cape in game.
The yew log is reserved for the church roof in the draft so purchasing an ordinary log cannot satisfy the cut-and-burn task.
The Fancy Stone task covers a fresh main or a saved homeowner with another house style. An existing Fancy Stone homeowner needs a separate change-of-style route.
The growth timers estimate healthy crops at nominal cycle lengths. Belladonna has no paid gardener and disease recovery is conditional. The yew plan pays the gardener when planting.

Belladonna harvest, chopped yew logs and roots use conservative item counts. The yew forecast credits one log and its Woodcutting XP. Extra logs and roots and incidental weeding XP are outside the forecast.
Plant yew at Farming 60. Preserve Farming 68 for when the spade is used, and dig promptly after felling to avoid regrowth. Confirm patch growth and regrowth timings in game.
